message.content:
An editorial illustration displays a man’s upper body and head in an illustrative style. He wears a tan vest with a round blue and red logo and a light shirt. He holds a large black machine gun with both hands. The gun belt, rather than bullets, contains white vials with orange bands. Several loose vials float around the man and the weapon. The man has short brown hair, lined skin, and a tired expression.

Text at the top reads "EVALUASI SETAHUN PANDEMI COVID-19" and "MANUVER GELAP MOELDOKO DI DEMOKRAT". The large masthead "TEMPO" is centered above the man. Below it, the text reads "INVESTIGASI MUDARAT DARURAT CORONA" followed by a paragraph starting with "Kisruh pengadaan alat tes virus corona berpotensi merugikan negara ratusan miliar rupiah." The paragraph continues in Indonesian, mentioning Doni Monardo and "reagen." Small text in the bottom left includes dates "15-21 MARET 2021," a price, and a barcode. A red border frames the left and bottom edges of the composition. The background is a solid dark grey.
